english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a deliberate attempt or effort.
This is the all-purpose noun for a neutral attempt or effort.
Use this as the ordinary noun for an attempt, such as an attempt at writing.
Use this for a discrete attempt or trial rather than the exertion involved in doing something.
